content.text: [Sat 2026-05-09 06:23 UTC] Create a script that periodically clears the ~/.bash_history file for the root user.

arguments.content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# Clears root's bash history file.
# NOTE: This does not clear in-memory history of already-running shells.

HIST_FILE="/root/.bash_history"

# Truncate safely (create if missing)
: > "$HIST_FILE"

# Restrict permissions
chmod 600 "$HIST_FILE" 2>/dev/null || true

# If a root interactive shell is running, attempt to tell it to reload/truncate.
# (Best-effort; no guarantees across sessions)
if command -v pkill >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  pkill -u root -SIGUSR1 bash 2>/dev/null || true
fi
